description.value: A private, year-round RV park in the heart of Harrison Hot Springs village, one block from Harrison Lake and the famous hot springs pool, with 21 fully serviced sites; the park caters to RVs only — no tent camping is mentioned and the booking form accepts motorhomes and trailers exclusively.

address.value: 272 Lillooet Ave, Harrison Hot Springs, BC, Canada V0M 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is Hot Springs RV & Camping Park in Harrison Hot Springs with 21 fully serviced RV sites, open year-round. Phone is confirmed matching between OSM and website. The FAQ confirms reservations by phone and email. However, there is no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodations — all site descriptions focus on RV hookups ('fully serviced RV sites', 'pull through site for those larger RV's'). The OSM name 'Hot Spring RV' differs from the website name 'Hot Springs RV & Camping Park'. Complimentary WiFi is mentioned on the rates page.
